name: Omaphones
author: Jacek Becela
description: Battery and noise control for wireless headphones in the bar. Earbuds show left, right and case levels; ANC / Ambient switching works on JBL and Sony. One icon per connected set.

barWidget.description: Battery and noise control for wireless headphones in the bar. Earbuds show left, right and case levels; ANC / Ambient switching works on JBL and Sony. One icon per connected set.

schema.label: Device name or address contains
schema.description: Leave empty to show every connected audio device; set a substring to follow only the matching ones.

schema.label: Read battery over Google Fast Pair
schema.description: Opens the Fast Pair Message Stream channel on the headphones for their levels — left, right and case on earbuds, one figure on a headset. Turn off to use only the single figure BlueZ reports — that also turns off noise control on JBL earbuds, which are reached at a BLE address announced only on this channel. Sony headsets serve their own channel and are unaffected.

schema.label: Noise control (ANC / Ambient)
schema.description: Holds one link to the headphones so the panel can switch Noise Cancelling, Ambient and Off, and so it hears changes made on the device itself. Sony headsets that speak the MDR protocol v2 (WH/WF, e.g. WH-CH720N) are controlled over their own RFCOMM channel and need no Fast Pair. JBL earbuds are reached over BLE at an address announced only on the Message Stream, so they need Fast Pair above, and only some models answer. The row is hidden for a device that answers for neither.

schema.label: Show a percentage instead of the drawn meters
schema.description: On writes the lower earbud's percentage next to the headphones glyph and takes a second bar slot whenever there is a level to write. Off fills the left and right halves of one drawn headphones mark, in a single icon slot. A vertical bar always draws the mark.

schema.label: Hide the widget while nothing is connected
Send a notification at the low battery threshold
